business_summary.text: Meghmani Organics Limited is a manufacturer of agrochemicals and pigments, with a focus on Crop Protection, Crop Nutrition, and Pigment segments.

call_points.text: FY27 standalone revenue: double-digit growth in Crop Protection segment
